title: 第五章 翻脸不认人第六章 迷幻散
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
灵元两个字，震得整个包间传来嗡嗡声，霍大师蕴含内气而发，形成一股气劲，扫向四周，桌子上摆放的水果，散落一地。
天灵丹是他拿出来的删减版，功效不及原配方万分之一，放到沧澜城，绝对是数一数二的好丹药。
关于天灵丹的药效，丹方上有详细介绍，远远高出市面上目前销售的所有丹药，让他震惊是所需要的原材料，要比二品养心丹还要便宜十倍，都是市面上一些常见的普通灵药，例如鸡冠草这种药材，遍地都是。
“你竟然拿着一枚假的丹方前来胡闹，念你初犯，我可以饶你一次，赶紧从这里滚出去，不然休怪我不客气。”
霍大师眼角闪过一丝贪婪，很快掩饰下去，他如果能掌握天灵丹炼制之法，即可晋升三星炼丹师，前往大燕皇城，那里才是修士聚集之地，沧澜城偏居一偶，放到整个大燕皇朝，不过沧海一粟。
什么叫霸道？
这就是霸道，想要吞并丹方，翻脸比翻书都快，丹方上的药材配方，他早已了然如胸，给他一个月时间研究，必定能炼制出来。
诬陷柳无邪拿来一张假的丹方，其目的不言而喻，雷涛眼角露出一丝怪异之色。
以他对霍大师的了解，如果丹方真是假的，早就甩袖袍离开，甚至会大打出手。
眼前的一幕，让他有些捉摸不透了，这枚丹方的价值可以让堂堂二星炼丹师放弃尊严，诬陷一名小小的赘婿。
“啪啪啪……”
柳无邪突然拍掌，嘴角露出一抹浓浓的嘲讽，霍大师那贪婪的目光，自然逃不掉他的眼睛。
“丹宝阁真是让我大开眼界，一枚小小的丹方而已，让你们露出如此丑恶的嘴脸，今天还真是让我大开眼界。”
满脸讽刺，霍大师脸上红一阵青一阵，有些不好意思，雷涛更是低下头，一脸愧色。
“小子，你打伤我丹宝阁小厮，拿着假的丹方欺骗我们，罪该万死。”
霍大师彻底撕破脸皮，衣袍鼓荡，强横的气势，席卷而至，强行镇压柳无邪，找个罪名诬陷他，顺理成章拿到丹方，就算他将事情闹大，谁会相信一个废物的话，况且是小小的赘婿。
“杀我？”
“就凭你？”
柳无邪冷笑连连，目光直刺霍大师，毫无退缩之意，凌厉的双眼，犹如两道利剑，直刺霍大师的灵魂，让他身体一晃，差点一头栽倒，这是一双什么样的眼睛，可以看穿虚妄。
霍大师无比恼怒，在丹宝阁，他的地位仅次于阁主，雷涛见到他，都要客客气气，何曾遭到这样羞辱，被小小的蝼蚁吓到，目露凶光：“你找死，那我就成全你。”

一掌碾压柳无邪，雷涛想要阻止已经来不及了，他也没料到，事情发展成这样，霍大师突下杀手。
“你想早死，就尽管出手。
每次炼丹，你的颤中穴是不是传来剧烈疼痛，而且最近一两年，疼痛越发激烈，需要吞服止痛的药物，才能减缓。”
柳无邪静静地站在原地，连还手的姿态都没有，雷涛正要出言阻止，霍大师的手掌陡然收回，像是见了鬼一样盯着柳无邪。
这是他的秘密，他如何知晓，每次炼制丹药，颤中穴的确传来剧痛，最近几个月，痛得他欲仙欲死，想过自杀。
丹宝阁每月贩卖大量丹药，大部分培元丹，出自霍大师之手，这两个月时间，培元丹的数量，一再锐减，霍大师声称身体不舒服，大家倒也没在意。
“你……你怎么知道……”
他慌了，说出来他就后悔，岂不是承认柳无邪所说，想到颤中穴传来的痛苦，眼眸中闪过一丝哀求之色。
“你为了提升到二星炼丹师，强行吞服一枚破灵丹，导致心脏受损，心属火，你每次炼丹，操控火属性，心脏承受极大的压力，传递到你的颤中穴，不出三月，你必定一命呜呼。”
柳无邪倒没有隐藏，说出他身体里面的问题，霍大师脸色连连骤变，连他吞服破灵丹的事情，都被挖出来，像是被人扒光了衣服，站在他们面前。
雷涛嘴巴张得老大，破灵丹是禁忌丹药，吞服之后，产生的副作用极其明显，没有人愿意尝试。
“我该怎么办，你一定知道办法是不是。”
content_en:
The word "Ling Yuan" caused a buzzing sound to be heard throughout the private room. Master Huo contained his inner energy and released it, forming a force of energy that swept around. The fruits placed on the table were scattered all over the floor.
The Tianling Pill is an abridged version that he brought out, and its efficacy is less than one ten thousandth of the original formula. It is definitely one of the best pills in Canglan City.
As for the efficacy of the Tianling Pill, there was a detailed introduction in the prescription. It was far higher than all the pills currently sold on the market. What shocked him was that the raw materials required were ten times cheaper than the second-grade Heart-Nourishing Pill. They were common elixirs on the market, such as Cockscomb Herbs, which were available everywhere.
"You actually came here with a fake prescription to make mischief. This is your first offense. I will spare you this one time. Get out of here quickly, or you won't blame me for being rude."
A trace of greed flashed in the corner of Master Huo's eyes, and he quickly covered it up. If he could master the method of refining the Tianling Pill, he could be promoted to a three-star alchemist and go to Dayan Imperial City, where the monks gathered. Canglan City was just a drop in the ocean in the entire Great Yan Dynasty.
What is domineering?
This is domineering. If he wants to annex the elixir, he will fall out faster than flipping through a book. He already knows the medicinal ingredients and formulas on the elixir. If he is given a month to study, he will definitely be able to refine it.
Liu Wuxie was framed for bringing a fake prescription. The purpose was self-evident, and a strange look appeared in the corner of Lei Tao's eyes.
Based on his understanding of Master Huo, if the pill formula was true or false, he would have thrown away his sleeves and left long ago, or even fought.
The scene in front of him made him a little unpredictable. The value of this elixir could make a powerful two-star alchemist give up his dignity and falsely accuse a little son-in-law.
"Pa bang bang..."
Liu Wuxie suddenly clapped his hands, with a hint of sarcasm on his lips. Master Huo's greedy gaze could not escape his eyes.
"The Danbao Pavilion is really an eye-opener for me. It's just a small pill recipe that makes you show such an ugly face. It's really an eye-opener for me today."
With a face full of sarcasm, Master Huo's face turned red and blue, a little embarrassed, and Lei Tao lowered his head with a look of shame.
"Boy, you injured my Danbao Pavilion boy and deceived us with a fake prescription. You deserve death."
Master Huo completely broke his face, his robes fluttered, and he swept over with a tyrannical momentum. He forcibly suppressed Liu Wuxie, found a crime to frame him, and naturally obtained the prescription. Even if he made the matter bigger, who would believe the words of a loser, let alone a little son-in-law.
"Kill me?"
"Just you?"
Liu Wuxie sneered again and again, piercing Master Huo with his eyes without any intention of flinching. His sharp eyes were like two sharp swords, piercing Master Huo's soul, making him sway and almost fall down. What kind of eyes are these, they can see through illusions.
Master Huo was extremely angry. In Danbao Pavilion, his status was second only to the Pavilion Master. When Lei Tao saw him, he would be polite. He had never been humiliated like this. He was frightened by a little ant, and his eyes looked fierce: "You are looking for death, then I will help you."
A palm crushed Liu Wuxie, and it was too late for Lei Tao to stop him. He did not expect that things would develop like this, and Master Huo would suddenly kill him.
“If you want to die early, just take action.
Every time you make elixirs, do you feel severe pain in your Zhuanzhong acupoint? In the past year or two, the pain has become more and more intense, and you need to take painkillers to relieve it. "
Liu Wuxie stood quietly, without even a gesture of fighting back. Just as Lei Tao was about to say something to stop him, Master Huo suddenly retracted his palm and stared at Liu Wuxie as if he had seen a ghost.
This was his secret. How did he know that every time he refined the elixir, there was indeed severe pain in the Zhuanzhong acupoint. In recent months, the pain had made him want to die and even thought about committing suicide.
Danbao Pavilion sells a large number of elixirs every month. Most of the Peiyuan Dans are from the hands of Master Huo. In the past two months, the number of Peiyuan Dans has been sharply reduced again and again. Master Huo claimed that he was not feeling well. EveryoneNot that I cared.
"You...how do you know..."
He panicked and regretted saying it. Wasn't he admitting what Liu Wuxie said? Thinking of the pain coming from the Zhunzhong point, a trace of pleading flashed in his eyes.
"In order to be promoted to a two-star alchemist, you forcibly swallowed a spirit-breaking pill, which caused damage to your heart. The heart is fire. Every time you refine the pill and control the fire attribute, your heart is under great pressure, which is transmitted to your Zhuizhong point. Within three months, you will definitely die."
Liu Wuxie did not hide it. When he revealed the problems in his body, Master Huo's expression suddenly changed. Even the fact that he swallowed the spirit-breaking pill was revealed, as if someone had stripped off his clothes and stood in front of them.
Lei Tao's mouth opened wide. The Soul-Breaking Pill was a taboo pill. After swallowing it, the side effects were extremely obvious. No one was willing to try it.
"What should I do? You must know the solution, right?"
